status: TROG-A greybox room (docs/01-design/floor-01-troglodyte-integration.md section 4.1, the troglodyte run T0 to T3): geometry only, composed at load time from approved Floor 01 kit pieces by camera_lab::layout (no new art, not an authored level; the territory dressing is the separate AREA-TROG-01 work order), launched as the room trog_run of --scene f01_late (src/f01_trog.rs). The three troglodytes, the two low steps and the defeat_roster goal live in f01_trog_run.encounter.json, validated by src/encounter.rs.

scenarios.name: The Troglodyte Run
scenarios.subtitle: Floor 01 troglodyte territory: the Pygmy, the Basher and the Virtuoso, one at a time
scenarios.purpose: A 2304 px scrolling hall of four pockets on one continuous floor lane: T0 the approach (no enemy can see the spawn), T1 the low hunter (the Pygmy at 640 and a 32 px low refuge), T2 the fist-shaped hole (the Basher at 1376 on a flat lane) and T3 the bell and the tongue (a 32 px step, a 64 px platform and the Virtuoso at 2144). The steps and the enemies live in the encounter sidecar, the platform here.
scenarios.expected: Spawns, the checkpoint, the exit, the low steps and the roster come from f01_trog_run.encounter.json; this file holds geometry only. The exit opens when all three troglodytes are defeated.
scenarios.coop: Solo with the companion, or two players: every critical route is open to both heroes; the 64 px platform is a Carl-class vantage (Donut needs her boost), never a gate.
